title: rosa agrestis subsp. abscondita
intro: Rosa agrestis subsp. abscondita, commonly known as the wild rose or dog rose, is a subspecies of the Rosa agrestis species, characterized by its fragrant flowers and edible fruits. The health benefits of Rosa agrestis subsp. abscondita include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health due to its high content of antioxidants and flavonoids. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use as an anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant, which can help to soothe skin irritations and wounds, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Rosa agrestis subsp. abscondita include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
